source_book: Sri Chaitanya — FAST TRACK IPE for Jr. Students, Mathematics-IB (2026-27 edition)
note: Question index for diffing and authoring. Stems restated in our own wording; the mathematics is exact. No solution content from the source book appears in this file, by policy.

questions.stem: Find the angle between the planes x + 2y + 2z − 5 = 0 and 3x + 3y + 2z − 8 = 0.
questions.notes: Printed as 1.***(i); the number itself is unstarred and the stars sit on each sub-part. The two parts are independent problems with separate solutions, so they are emitted as separate objects.

questions.stem: Find the angle between the planes 2x − y + z − 6 = 0 and x + y + 2z − 7 = 0.
Find the intercepts of the plane 4x + 3y − 2z + 2 = 0 on the coordinate axes.
Find the equation of the plane whose intercepts on the X, Y, Z axes are 1, 2, 4 respectively.
Write the equation of the plane 4x − 4y + 2z + 5 = 0 in the intercept form.
Reduce the equation x + 2y − 3z − 6 = 0 of the plane into the normal form.
Find the direction cosines of the normal to the plane x + 2y + 2z − 4 = 0.
questions.notes: Star prefix sits in the clipped spine gutter; two glyphs readable and a third may be lost, so 2 is recorded as the readable value.

questions.stem: Find the equation of the plane passing through the point (1, 1, 1) and parallel to the plane x + 2y + 3z − 7 = 0.
questions.notes: Star prefix sits in the clipped spine gutter; two glyphs readable and a third may be lost.

questions.stem: Find the equation of the plane passing through the point (−2, 1, 3) and having (3, −5, 4) as the direction ratios of its normal.
Find the equation of the plane if the foot of the perpendicular from the origin to the plane is (1, 3, −5).
